record.bible_text: So king<WH04428> Solomon<WH08010> was king<WH04428> over all Israel<WH03478>.

The son of Dekar<WH01128><WTH8677><WH01857>, in Makaz<WH04739>, and in Shaalbim<WH08169>, and Bethshemesh<WH01053>, and Elonbethhanan<WH0358>: <RF>The son...: or, Bendekar<Rf>

Jehoshaphat<WH03092> the son<WH01121> of Paruah<WH06515>, in Issachar<WH03485>:
Shimei<WH08096> the son<WH01121> of Elah<WH0414>, in Benjamin<WH01144>:

Judah<WH03063> and Israel<WH03478> <FI>were<Fi> many<WH07227>, as the sand<WH02344> which <FI>is<Fi> by the sea<WH03220> in multitude<WH07230>, eating<WH0398><WTH8802> and drinking<WH08354><WTH8802>, and making merry<WH08056>.

And Solomon<WH08010> reigned<WH04910><WTH8802> over all kingdoms<WH04467> from the river<WH05104> unto the land<WH0776> of the Philistines<WH06430>, and unto the border<WH01366> of Egypt<WH04714>: they brought<WH05066><WTH8688> presents<WH04503>, and served<WH05647><WTH8802> Solomon<WH08010> all the days<WH03117> of his life<WH02416>.

And Solomon's<WH08010> provision<WH03899> for one<WH0259> day<WH03117> was thirty<WH07970> measures<WH03734> of fine flour<WH05560>, and threescore<WH08346> measures<WH03734> of meal<WH07058>, <RF>provision: Heb. bread<Rf> <RF>measures: Heb. cors<Rf>

Ten<WH06235> fat<WH01277> oxen<WH01241>, and twenty<WH06242> oxen<WH01241> out of the pastures<WH07471>, and an hundred<WH03967> sheep<WH06629>, beside harts<WH0354>, and roebucks<WH06643>, and fallowdeer<WH03180>, and fatted<WH075><WTH8803> fowl<WH01257>.

For he had dominion<WH07287><WTH8802> over all <FI>the region<Fi> on this side<WH05676> the river<WH05104>, from Tiphsah<WH08607> even to Azzah<WH05804>, over all the kings<WH04428> on this side<WH05676> the river<WH05104>: and he had peace<WH07965> on all sides<WH05650><WTH8676><WH05676> round about<WH05439> him.

And Judah<WH03063> and Israel<WH03478> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> safely<WH0983>, every man<WH0376> under his vine<WH01612> and under his fig tree<WH08384>, from Dan<WH01835> even to Beersheba<WH0884>, all the days<WH03117> of Solomon<WH08010>. <RF>safely: Heb. confidently<Rf>
And Solomon<WH08010> had forty<WH0705> thousand<WH0505> stalls<WH0723> of horses<WH05483> for his chariots<WH04817>, and twelve<WH08147><WH06240> thousand<WH0505> horsemen<WH06571>.

And those officers<WH05324><WTH8737> provided victual<WH03557><WTH8773> for king<WH04428> Solomon<WH08010>, and for all that came<WH07131> unto king<WH04428> Solomon's<WH08010> table<WH07979>, every man<WH0376> in his month<WH02320>: they lacked<WH05737><WTH8762> nothing<WH01697>.

Barley<WH08184> also and straw<WH08401> for the horses<WH05483> and dromedaries<WH07409> brought<WH0935><WTH8686> they unto the place<WH04725> where <FI>the officers<Fi> were, every man<WH0376> according to his charge<WH04941>. <RF>dromedaries: or, mules, or, swift beasts<Rf><CM>

And God<WH0430> gave<WH05414><WTH8799> Solomon<WH08010> wisdom<WH02451> and understanding<WH08394> exceeding<WH03966> much<WH07235><WTH8687>, and largeness<WH07341> of heart<WH03820>, even as the sand<WH02344> that <FI>is<Fi> on the sea<WH03220> shore<WH08193>.

For he was wiser<WH02449><WTH8799> than all men<WH0120>; than Ethan<WH0387> the Ezrahite<WH0250>, and Heman<WH01968>, and Chalcol<WH03633>, and Darda<WH01862>, the sons<WH01121> of Mahol<WH04235>: and his fame<WH08034> was in all nations<WH01471> round about<WH05439>.
And he spake<WH01696><WTH8762> three<WH07969> thousand<WH0505> proverbs<WH04912>: and his songs<WH07892> were a thousand<WH0505> and five<WH02568>.

And he spake<WH01696><WTH8762> of trees<WH06086>, from the cedar tree<WH0730> that <FI>is<Fi> in Lebanon<WH03844> even unto the hyssop<WH0231> that springeth out<WH03318><WTH8802> of the wall<WH07023>: he spake<WH01696><WTH8762> also of beasts<WH0929>, and of fowl<WH05775>, and of creeping things<WH07431>, and of fishes<WH01709>.
